text:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a roadtest for rwd-stella-13b v2 with FP8 and AWQ-INT8 variants. Goal: validate quality delta on our goldens + ensure graceful fallback in hosted->private handoff. Thoughts? :rocket:
aj: love it. what sample mix were you thinking for canary?
kevin: propose 1% production traffic to FP8, 1% to AWQ, hold rest on fp16 baseline. ramp rules: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 24h if no regressions.
sara: what's our regression definition? LM perplexity or end-to-end task F1? also need prompt coverage for safety prompts.
maria: short answer: both. primary gate = weighted QA F1 drop <= 1.5% on goldens. secondary gates: hallucination / toxicity checks (blocking if any safety threshold crossed). sample mix: 60% QA, 20% summarization, 10% code, 10% convo fallback.
aj: ok. can we get quick eval numbers offline first? even small eval harness with 500 examples per slice.
maria: yes — I ran quick sims earlier, AWQ int8 had -0.9% F1 on QA, FP8 had -1.2% but slightly faster p50. raw numbers attached in the experiment run id: exp/rwd-stella13b/v2/roadtest-009
kevin: sounds promising. need rollout policy spec to feed into the deploy pipeline. something like:
```yaml
rollout:
  variants:
    - name: fp16
      weight: 98
    - name: fp8
      weight: 1
    - name: awq-int8
      weight: 1
  gates:
    - name: qa_f1
      threshold: -1.5  # percent relative
    - name: safety_block
      threshold: 0     # any failure blocks
  ramp: [1,5,20]
  probe_size: 500
```
sara: also add "fallback-to": "fp16" and a max-error-rate gate (5xx ratio) so we don't route during infra flaps.
maria: good call. will update. also want a KV-cache warmup probe for private infra since latency can spike on cold starts. microbatch sizes differ on-prem.
aj: how about metric capture? need token-level latency, tail p95/p99, and cost-per-token estimate for both envs.
kevin: add region-aware routing: hosted first, if region quota hit then route to dedicated, then private. fallback policy: if both quant variants fail gate, auto-fallback to fp16 for that user-session for 1h.
maria: noted. I'll draft the canary playbook and sample selection script. planning to push config and eval results to the experiment bundle by EOD.

aj: I'll volunteer to run the golden eval harness and sanity checks once infra is up.
sara: I'll curate the safety prompts and run the toxicity ensemble.
maria: thanks — will post the canary dashboard (shortlink) when data streams in. please flag any unexpected drops ASAP. :eyes: 
kevin: if we see any >2.5% QA regression at probe_size=500, auto-cut to 0 for that variant and notify oncall.
maria: agreed. setting alert: qa_drop_percent >= 2.0 -> page eng-ml oncall.
kevin: tiny nit — include a predictable seed set for the first probe run so results are reproducible.
maria: done. seed-ids will be in the bundle.

maria: thanks team. next check-in after 1st probe (~30m). :thumbsup:
